title: Airtable MAC header output, public ids, lookalike fields and non-values
summary: An X-Airtable-Content-MAC HMAC output, webhook and base ids beside the field, a field whose name only resembles it, and placeholders, references and masked values under the exact field.
rationale: The MAC header is a hash of a delivery body computed with the secret, so it does not reveal the secret; webhook and base ids are public identifiers; a flag such as macSecretBase64Present is a boolean about the secret and carries none of it. Placeholders, references and masked text carry no value.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, credential-evidence#232). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Not flagged under project policy. Airtable documents the header as a hash of the body using the hook's MAC secret; that this output is not the secret, that ids are public and that placeholders and references are not values are the project's decisions.

sources.supports: A hash of the body contents using the hook's MAC secret is given in the X-Airtable-Content-MAC header.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. All values are synthetic, were built for this record and were not tested against any service. The carrier's existence is what the cited provider pages document; the value admission, span, placeholder handling and attribution are project policy. Parser behaviour, action and product attribution stay with the downstream repositories.
